sloka: तद्भवानद्य काशेय पुरीं वाराणसीं व्रज ।रमणीयां त्वया गुप्तां सुप्रकाशां सुतोरणाम् ।। ७.३८.१८ ॥
transliteration: tadbhavānadya kāśeya purīṁ vārāṇasīṁ vraja ।ramaṇīyāṁ tvayā guptāṁ suprakāśāṁ sutoraṇām ।। 7.38.18 ॥

translations.english: Therefore, O King of Kashi, you should go today to your beautiful city of Varanasi, which is protected by you, well-illuminated, and adorned with beautiful arches.
